decisions.authorityA: Pearl.docx: one Loose Pearl record may represent one pearl or a homogeneous group with quantity > 1
decisions.authorityB: Frozen DARFUS: one physical piece = one Asset; quantity-based inventory forbidden
decisions.whyCannotCoexist: Current Asset schema has no quantity authority and runtime rejects PRIMARY_SUBJECT componentCount > 1; partial group sale/consume/transfer/split semantics are undefined
decisions.optionA: Normalize Loose Pearl to one physical pearl per Asset and treat client group wording as a future aggregation/reporting requirement
decisions.optionB: Approve a group Asset/quantity/split authority with explicit identity, cost, weight, barcode, lineage, and partial-operation semantics
decisions.recommendation: Owner must choose before implementation; do not infer
decisions.impact: P1; blocks implementation contract freeze and runtime acceptance

decisions.authorityA: Pearl.docx: Supplier Name optional and may be manual/unknown
decisions.authorityB: Canonical Supplier Receive V2: supplierId is required before PO/Asset/Payable posting
decisions.whyCannotCoexist: The only current purchased-stock receive path rejects missing supplierId; creating an Unknown supplier is forbidden
decisions.optionA: Require canonical Supplier for purchased stock and define optional Supplier only for a separately approved non-purchase intake
decisions.optionB: Approve a new non-supplier acquisition path with its own accounting/source authority
decisions.recommendation: Owner must choose before implementation; do not create fake supplier
